To improve the complexity, sort and coordinate-compress the values when computing in-degrees, and use a Fenwick tree to track previously scanned heights during a left-to-right sweep. Use a segment tree to optimize range updates to in-degrees during topological sorting: store minimum values, query the root, and binary-search for the interval whose in-degrees need updating.

When historical KV is stored externally, a cache hit avoids recomputation but still requires reading it back. In a cluster with disaggregated prefill and decode, the original data path concentrates storage traffic on prefill machines' network interfaces while those on decode machines may sit idle, leaving GPUs waiting for data.

Low reuse of final answers is an assumption of this paper’s workload; in multi-turn chat they may enter the next turn’s history, so the fixed order cannot be copied directly. Scheduling also preserves the arrival order of whole agent requests.

KV 在 CPU 与 GPU 之间的搬运也经过配对 CNIC，通过 RDMA（远.en: KV transfers between CPU and GPU also go through paired CNICs and are transmitted via RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access). This places both local transfers and cross-machine transfers under NIC traffic-priority control. The model’s expert-parallel and collective communication use high-priority queues; KV traffic uses low-priority queues, using spare bandwidth while reserving a minimum service share. Routing through the NIC adds a path but provides unified isolation that ordinary CUDA copies cannot achieve.
